sources.entry: RecurseChat - Local-first AI chat app with customizable workflows.

summary.name: RecurseChat
summary.one_liner: RecurseChat is a Mac app for chatting with local LLMs, Claude, and ChatGPT, with local file chat (RAG) and a floating summon-anywhere window.
use_cases: chat with local LLMs privately on a Mac
ask questions about PDF or markdown files
summon an AI chat over any app with a hotkey
continue imported ChatGPT conversations with local models
use Claude and ChatGPT from one Mac app
summary.what_it_does:
The page describes RecurseChat as a single Mac app for chatting with local AI models as well as Claude and ChatGPT. Local models run directly on the Mac, and the page says conversations do not leave the device and no internet connection is needed. A floating chat window is summoned with Cmd+Shift+Enter from any app and stays on top of other windows. Users can chat with PDFs, markdown and text files using local RAG with on-device embeddings and vector search. Model sources listed are GGUF models, Hugging Face, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, and cloud providers such as Claude and ChatGPT, and the app can import ChatGPT history.</what_it_does>
